notes: Sync no longer drops what you did on your other device (live mocks, reel checks, playbook, ticks, streak days), and stops safely if it cannot read the server first.
Two open tabs no longer overwrite each other's progress.
Backups leave out your API key and sync URL; restoring keeps this device's.
Questions and AI replies can no longer run code in the app; older questions show the day they were found.
AI scores say they can be wrong, and an incomplete AI reply lets you mark yourself instead of scoring 1.
Every section now has reels at four levels: new to it, how it works, inside and caveats, architect.
